sanskrit.title: Bhagavad Gītā
sanskrit.edition: Ved Vyas Foundation's gita/gita digital Sanskrit transcription
sanskrit.scope: 18 chapters; 701 verse records in this digital edition; not a critically collated text
sanskrit.disclaimer: This is one attributed digital transcription. Verse numbering or readings may vary across editions. Its transliteration is not a verified traditional IAST witness. No English translation is automatically aligned with this text.
